title: Eritrea — Strengthening Tax Administration Project (ESTAP) (AfDB)
description: Strengthening Tax Administration Project (ESTAP), project code P-ER-K00-002, loan/grant number 5900155015701. Financing of UAC 2,000,000 from the Fragile States Facility (TSF Pillar 3), approved 19.06.2019, signed and in force 20.08.2019, effective for first disbursement 20.08.2019, disbursement deadline 31.12.2026. Borrower and guarantor: Government of Eritrea; executing agency: Ministry of Finance. The project's objective is "to promote economic growth and effective implementation of the national development plan through increased domestic tax revenue collections and creating additional fiscal space". Its principal output is the Eritrea Integrated Tax Administration System (ErITAS): per the Bank's desk supervision of 8–9 June 2026, software licences and installation, hardware delivery and installation, and the Release 1 software requirements specification are complete, and implementation progress and the development objective are both rated satisfactory.

scope_basis: Finances financial management and debt information systems and statistical capacity.
title: Eritrea — PFM and Statistics Technical Assistance and Capacity Building Project (AfDB)
description:
The African Development Bank's Fragile States Facility (TSF Pillar 3) approved UAC 9,000,000 on 4 July 2016 for the PFM and Statistics Technical Assistance and Capacity Building Project (P-ER-KF0-003), signed 10 October 2016, entering into force the same day, effective for first disbursement 25 November 2016. The project's objective is to build transparency and accountability in public financial management through an Integrated Financial Management Information System (IFMIS), a Debt Management and Financial Analysis System (DMFAS), and statistical-capacity building.

Per the AfDB's February 2026 Implementation Progress Report (mission 30 November–30 December 2025): 81.65% disbursed; the IFMIS (seven modules — budgeting, procurement, payroll, cash management, accounting, asset control, reporting) completed pilot rollout and User Acceptance Testing at the Ministries of Finance, Education and Agriculture, generating reconciled reports by end-November 2025 and declared ready for go-live; DMFAS was installed, enabling automated quarterly and annual debt reporting since 2019; the National Statistics Office was equipped with servers, computers and software to establish its own data centre, supporting GDP estimates and the 2025 Population and Health Survey. Government-wide IFMIS rollout is targeted for the 2027 budget cycle, contingent on reliable power, IT infrastructure and connectivity upgrades. Public Procurement and Asset Management laws were drafted under the project and are under stakeholder consultation as of the report date.
original_amount: UAC 9,000,000 (foreign currency UAC 4,500,000 + local currency UAC 4,500,000)
